You&#39;ll join a small HR Operations team during our Rippling implementation, which means greenfield opportunity and real influence over how our data is structured for the next few years.


What you&#39;ll do

Own the numbers

 - Own headcount, attrition and people cost reporting end to end

 - Build the exec and board level reporting our leadership relies on

 - Define what our metrics mean, rather than producing whatever is asked for

Fix the data underneath

 - Reconcile People and Finance headcount, and keep them reconciled

 - Clean up the taxonomies that make reporting unreliable, starting with termination reasons

 - Chase the data quality problems nobody has asked you to chase

 - Build the checks that stop bad data entering in the first place

Own the data model

 - Own our employee data model, definitions and governance

 - Work with the HRIS team so the system supports the reporting we need

 - Push and challenge current systems to meet your data vision

Own benefits administration and records

 - Own US and global benefits administration, renewal cycles and open enrolment

 - Own employee records, employment verification and data requests

 - Support the front line team who handle day to day employee questions

Make reporting self-serve

 - Automate the recurring reporting so it produces itself

 - Give managers and leaders access to their own numbers

 - Reduce the number of requests that need a person at all

Build for what&#39;s coming

 - Produce reporting that stands up to audit and external diligence

 - Work with Finance and IT on the controls and evidence our data needs to carry

 - Design for a company several times our current size


You may be a good fit if you

 - 5+ years of people analytics and reporting experience, within fast-paced, scaling environments

 - Meaningful experience delivering people operations solutions across all aspects of the talent journey

 - Experienced in HRIS implementation or migration

 - Experience building reports from scratch

 - Proactively identify and resolve data quality issues, maintaining high standards for clean, reliable analytics data

 - Effectively communicate data insights by explaining numerical findings, their source methodology, and rationale for discrepancies with alternative interpretations

 - Write clearly and document by default

 - Have run operations across multiple countries and entities, including EOR or contractor populations

 - Are comfortable anywhere across the employee journey, from hire to exit

 - Pick up new tools quickly and become the person others ask

 - Enjoy building elegant solutions to messy operational problems

Bonus if you have

 - Worked in Rippling, or implemented it

 - Built reporting in a BI tool, or worked comfortably in SQL

 - Been in a company through IPO readiness or SOC 2 and SOX preparation


WHAT WE&#39;RE NOT LOOKING FOR

Someone who waits for a report request and fills it. This role decides what we measure and makes the underlying data good enough to trust. If you would rather be handed a spec than write one, this is not the role for you.


FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts &amp; culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education &amp; learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.


HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

  <meta name="description" content="ABOUT ONELEET

Oneleet is one of the fastest-growing security and compliance platforms in history. We are on a mission to change the compliance and security industry by making cybersecurity and compliance effective, easy, and painless. We provide a platform that helps companies build, manage, and monitor their cybersecurity programs and achieve compliance standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 efficiently, without cutting corners.

Having just raised a $33 million Series A, we are rapidly growing in customers and employees. Our team has decades of experience in security and compliance. Join our team of opinionated rebels and help us build a category-defining company reshaping the broken and fragmented compliance and cybersecurity industry.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We value passionate self-starters with a growth mindset and a bias for action and personal accountability. If you love solving hard problems, thrive in ambiguity, and want to make a real impact, you’ll fit right in.

We’re especially drawn to:

 - Rebels with a cause — frustrated with the status quo and eager to disrupt it.

 - Opinionated (but not obstinate) builders — decisive yet collaborative, who help us move fast.

 - Clear communicators — who own their ideas and follow through.

Our mission is simple: make effective cybersecurity painless. We believe cybersecurity should empower, not burden. This belief unites our team and drives every decision we make.

If you’re ready to challenge the status quo and help shape the future of cybersecurity, we’d love to meet you.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The GTM Data &amp; Attribution Engineer at Oneleet will own the data backbone of our go-to-market motion, from first ad click to closed-won deal. You’ll work alongside our GTM Engineer, and you will have a deep focus on synthesizing funnel insights between marketing and sales. You will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing all of our marketing and sales data.

You will build and maintain the pipeline that pulls data from HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, LinkedIn, PostHog, and our website into BigQuery as a single, trustworthy source of truth. You will be the person who can explain, with certainty, why HubSpot says one number and Google Ads says another, and which one to believe. You will turn that clean data into dashboards executives actually use, and into account intelligence that makes our ABM and outbound motions sharper.

You will thrive here if you get genuinely excited building motions from scratch, about reconciling conflicting numbers across platforms, if you understand browsers and tracking well enough to explain why the discrepancy exists, and if you’d rather build a pipeline once, correctly, than patch the same spreadsheet every week.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Data gathering &amp; Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and manage our data pipeline in BigQuery, unifying data from HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, LinkedIn, PostHog, and the website into one reliable source of truth. Document the pipeline so it scales beyond you and survives tool changes.

 - Attribution &amp; Tracking: Maintain deep, working knowledge of how browsers work, how data is sent, and how cookies, JavaScript, and (server-side) GTM are used. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between platforms and explain why to stakeholders, not just report the gap.

 - Dreamdata &amp; Revenue Attribution: Configure and continuously refine Dreamdata to model the full prospect journey, anonymous visitor to closed-won. Use Dreamdata to determine which channels and campaigns are actually generating pipeline. Partner with sales and marketing to translate Dreamdata insights into budget and channel decisions.

 - Visualization &amp; Reporting: Build and maintain a clear, executive-facing dashboard (Looker/Looker Studio) showing the performance by channel: spend, leads, meetings, pipeline, and closed-won. Ensure dashboards answer “where is revenue actually coming from?” at a glance, with the ability to drill into any channel or campaign. Keep reporting logic consistent with the underlying attribution model so numbers don’t silently diverge.

 - ABM with Clay &amp; AI: Design and run an ABM strategy grounded in our ICP, using Clay to enrich and score accounts, layering in firmographic, intent, and behavioral signals. Leverage AI to personalize messaging at scale in a way that actually gets replies.


REQUIREMENTS:

General:

 - 5+ years in GTM operations, revenue operations, marketing operations, or analytics engineering at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on ownership of marketing/sales data infrastructure.

 - Scientific mindset of experimentation, creating and testing hypotheses.

 - Love of working on new platforms that help automate and enhance channel performance. 

 - Knowledge of how to simplify and act on findings. 

Technical:

 - Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience building and maintaining pipelines in BigQuery (or a comparable warehouse).

 - Deep understanding of how browsers, cookies, JavaScript, and tracking pixels work. Able to diagnose why numbers differ across platforms, not just flag that they do.

 - Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM and data layer configuration.

 - Experience with Dreamdata or a comparable B2B attribution platform (Bizible, HubSpot Attribution, etc.).

 - Hands-on HubSpot experience (CRM, Marketing Hub, Operations Hub): workflows, custom objects, data sync.

 - BI tool proficiency (Looker / Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar). Building dashboards, not just reading them.

 - Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and data integration patterns across platforms not designed to talk to each other.

Strategic:

 - Deep understanding of B2B SaaS funnels, buyer journeys, and revenue metrics (MQL, SQL, pipeline, win rate, CAC, LTV).

 - Experience designing and implementing UTM strategies and multi-touch attribution models.

 - Understanding of ABM fundamentals: ICP definition, account scoring, and personalized outbound at scale.

 - Cross-functional communication skills. Able to explain a tracking discrepancy to a sales rep and an attribution model to a CEO with equal clarity.


NICE-TO-HAVE

 - Experience at an early-stage startup as the first or only data/ops hire.

 - Experience with Clay (workflows, enrichment, AI columns, Claygent).

 - Python scripting for data manipulation and automation.

 - Experience with PostHog or similar product analytics tools.

 - Familiarity with reverse ETL tooling and broader data warehousing concepts.

 - HubSpot certifications (Revenue Operations, Marketing Hub, Operations Hub).

 - Google Ads campaign management and conversion optimization experience.

Oneleet is one of the fastest-growing security and compliance platforms in history. We are on a mission to change the compliance and security industry by making cybersecurity and compliance effective, easy, and painless. We provide a platform that helps companies build, manage, and monitor their cybersecurity programs and achieve compliance standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 efficiently, without cutting corners.

Having just raised a $33 million Series A, we are rapidly growing in customers and employees. Our team has decades of experience in security and compliance. Join our team of opinionated rebels and help us build a category-defining company reshaping the broken and fragmented compliance and cybersecurity industry.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We value passionate self-starters with a growth mindset and a bias for action and personal accountability. If you love solving hard problems, thrive in ambiguity, and want to make a real impact, you’ll fit right in.

We’re especially drawn to:

 - Rebels with a cause — frustrated with the status quo and eager to disrupt it.

 - Opinionated (but not obstinate) builders — decisive yet collaborative, who help us move fast.

 - Clear communicators — who own their ideas and follow through.

Our mission is simple: make effective cybersecurity painless. We believe cybersecurity should empower, not burden. This belief unites our team and drives every decision we make.

If you’re ready to challenge the status quo and help shape the future of cybersecurity, we’d love to meet you.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The GTM Data &amp; Attribution Engineer at Oneleet will own the data backbone of our go-to-market motion, from first ad click to closed-won deal. You’ll work alongside our GTM Engineer, and you will have a deep focus on synthesizing funnel insights between marketing and sales. You will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing all of our marketing and sales data.

You will build and maintain the pipeline that pulls data from HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, LinkedIn, PostHog, and our website into BigQuery as a single, trustworthy source of truth. You will be the person who can explain, with certainty, why HubSpot says one number and Google Ads says another, and which one to believe. You will turn that clean data into dashboards executives actually use, and into account intelligence that makes our ABM and outbound motions sharper.

You will thrive here if you get genuinely excited building motions from scratch, about reconciling conflicting numbers across platforms, if you understand browsers and tracking well enough to explain why the discrepancy exists, and if you’d rather build a pipeline once, correctly, than patch the same spreadsheet every week.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Data gathering &amp; Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and manage our data pipeline in BigQuery, unifying data from HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, LinkedIn, PostHog, and the website into one reliable source of truth. Document the pipeline so it scales beyond you and survives tool changes.

 - Attribution &amp; Tracking: Maintain deep, working knowledge of how browsers work, how data is sent, and how cookies, JavaScript, and (server-side) GTM are used. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between platforms and explain why to stakeholders, not just report the gap.

 - Dreamdata &amp; Revenue Attribution: Configure and continuously refine Dreamdata to model the full prospect journey, anonymous visitor to closed-won. Use Dreamdata to determine which channels and campaigns are actually generating pipeline. Partner with sales and marketing to translate Dreamdata insights into budget and channel decisions.

 - Visualization &amp; Reporting: Build and maintain a clear, executive-facing dashboard (Looker/Looker Studio) showing the performance by channel: spend, leads, meetings, pipeline, and closed-won. Ensure dashboards answer “where is revenue actually coming from?” at a glance, with the ability to drill into any channel or campaign. Keep reporting logic consistent with the underlying attribution model so numbers don’t silently diverge.

 - ABM with Clay &amp; AI: Design and run an ABM strategy grounded in our ICP, using Clay to enrich and score accounts, layering in firmographic, intent, and behavioral signals. Leverage AI to personalize messaging at scale in a way that actually gets replies.


REQUIREMENTS:

General:

 - 5+ years in GTM operations, revenue operations, marketing operations, or analytics engineering at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on ownership of marketing/sales data infrastructure.

 - Scientific mindset of experimentation, creating and testing hypotheses.

 - Love of working on new platforms that help automate and enhance channel performance. 

 - Knowledge of how to simplify and act on findings. 

Technical:

 - Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience building and maintaining pipelines in BigQuery (or a comparable warehouse).

 - Deep understanding of how browsers, cookies, JavaScript, and tracking pixels work. Able to diagnose why numbers differ across platforms, not just flag that they do.

 - Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM and data layer configuration.

 - Experience with Dreamdata or a comparable B2B attribution platform (Bizible, HubSpot Attribution, etc.).

 - Hands-on HubSpot experience (CRM, Marketing Hub, Operations Hub): workflows, custom objects, data sync.

 - BI tool proficiency (Looker / Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar). Building dashboards, not just reading them.

 - Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and data integration patterns across platforms not designed to talk to each other.

Strategic:

 - Deep understanding of B2B SaaS funnels, buyer journeys, and revenue metrics (MQL, SQL, pipeline, win rate, CAC, LTV).

 - Experience designing and implementing UTM strategies and multi-touch attribution models.

 - Understanding of ABM fundamentals: ICP definition, account scoring, and personalized outbound at scale.

 - Cross-functional communication skills. Able to explain a tracking discrepancy to a sales rep and an attribution model to a CEO with equal clarity.


NICE-TO-HAVE

 - Experience at an early-stage startup as the first or only data/ops hire.

 - Experience with Clay (workflows, enrichment, AI columns, Claygent).

 - Python scripting for data manipulation and automation.

 - Experience with PostHog or similar product analytics tools.

 - Familiarity with reverse ETL tooling and broader data warehousing concepts.

 - HubSpot certifications (Revenue Operations, Marketing Hub, Operations Hub).

 - Google Ads campaign management and conversion optimization experience.


WHY ONELEET?

At Oneleet, you’ll join a tight-knit team of rebels redefining the cybersecurity industry. We move fast, own our work, and challenge outdated models to make security effortless and effective for companies.

Here’s what makes us special:

 - We value impact over titles, autonomy over micromanagement, and clarity over jargon.

 - You’ll tackle meaningful, hard problems with real-world consequences.

 - You’ll work with smart, kind, and ambitious teammates who lift each other up.



PERKS &amp; BENEFITS

 - 20 days PTO per year, plus 8 floating holiday

 - Remote work culture

 - Team off-sites in stunning places (Amsterdam, Italy, etc).

 - Competitive compensation &amp; equity

We hire globally and compensate competitively within each market using geographic pay bands. The range for this role reflects a US national baseline. Offers for candidates in higher cost-of-labor markets (e.g., San Francisco, New York, Zurich) may fall at or above the top of the posted range, while offers in other markets are benchmarked to local standards and are lower. Within any range, individual compensation is determined by work location, skills and experience demonstrated through the interview process, and relevant education or training. This posting reflects base salary only and does not include equity or benefits.


Remote-First &amp; Global Hiring

Ambient.ai is the category creator and leader in Agentic Physical Security. Powered by Ambient Pulsar, the first reasoning Vision-Language Model purpose-built for physical security, our platform seamlessly integrates with existing security cameras and physical access control systems to unify monitoring, access control, threat assessment, response, and investigations through an always-on reasoning layer that augments security operators with superhuman capabilities. The results: 95% fewer false alarms, investigations 20x faster, and 10x faster response.

The momentum speaks for itself: we doubled new ARR in FY26, and have delivered results for world-class customers including Cisco, ServiceNow, SentinelOne, TikTok, Bayer, and MoMA. That kind of momentum creates an environment where great people thrive, and it shows: we recently ranked #71 out of 500 on the Forbes best startup employers list https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/.

Founded in 2017 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, and Allegion Ventures, Ambient.ai is on a fast-paced journey to fulfill our mission: prevent every security incident possible.

Ready to learn more? Connect with us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/ambient-ai/?viewAsMember=true and  YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@ambient-ai-inc

About the role:

We’re looking for top-tier Sales Engineers who thrive on winning Fortune 500 logos. You’re a driven, high-energy professional passionate about impactful technology and a knack for demonstrating its real-world business impact. In this pre-sales role, you’ll showcase Ambient.ai through compelling demos, lead business-value-driven pilots, craft value-driven proposals, and help cast a vision of how Ambient delivers measurable business outcomes. Your ability to translate technical capabilities into strategic advantages will be key to closing deals and driving customer success.

What you&#39;ll do:

 - Partner with Regional Sales Managers to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

 - Lead successful technical Pilots (proof of concepts/proof of values) with customers.

 - Ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Engineering teams to influence the roadmap, stay connected to the internal teams, and act as a voice of the customer.

 - Execute Business Value Assessments to anchor business value across stakeholders. 

 - Conduct engaging product demos and presentations to technical and non-technical audiences, effectively communicating the differentiated value proposition. 

 - You will win deals through world-class preparation and execution, by bringing a consultative approach to solving meaningful business problems.

 - Build strong customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor by providing technical expertise, answering technical inquiries, and proposing solutions.

What you&#39;ll bring:

 - Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills

 - Bachelor&#39;s degree in CS or a related field

 - Highly motivated, driven, and self-starting individual

 - Technical knowledge, consultative approach, and cross-functional collaboration skills

 - A customer-first attitude, belief in teamwork, and a competitive spirit to win

 - 5+ years of proven success selling enterprise technology, with a focus on SaaS and/or innovative hardware-based solutions

 - Clear examples of partnering with Sales to run complex technical deals with Enterprise customers

 - Solid understanding of L2 switching (VLANs, limitations of L2 vs. L3, physical vs. logical network isolation)

 - Basic Linux networking skills (assigning IP/mask/gateway to NICs, configuring MLAG/failover redundancy)

 - Familiarity with any cloud environment (GCP, AWS, Azure)

 - Bonus: Familiarity with security cameras, physical access control systems (PACS)

Why join us:

 - We are creating an entirely new category within a $120+ billion physical security industry and looking for team members who are also passionate about our mission to prevent every security incident possible 

 - We partner with an incredible customer roster of F500 companies, including Adobe, TikTok, Gap and SentinelOne

 - Regular Full-time employees receive stock options for the opportunity to share ownership in the success of our company 

 - Comprehensive health + welfare package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, Legal Services, 401k plan)

 - We offer flexible time off to rest and recharge, including Winter Break (time off between Christmas and New Year’s for most roles, depending on customer demand)

 - The latest tech and awesome swag will be delivered to your door

  <meta name="description" content="ABOUT PERPLEXITY AI

In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We’ve scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.

As an engineer at Perplexity, your role will be to build products and systems that define how AI empowers humans to think, decide and act. You’ll ship fast and work between both product and infrastructure advancements in our technology.


WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT

 - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious.

 - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it.

 - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users.

 - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products.

 - Partnership. We amplify each others&#39; strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Perplexity is looking for a software engineer to evolve the core agent harness that powers our flagship answer experience.

You will combine strong product judgment with both single- and multi-agent engineering paradigms to help us build the world’s foremost agent for accumulating knowledge and answering our society’s most challenging questions. You will translate user needs and quantitative insights into improvements to the agent’s orchestration, context management, performance, and reliability.

The ideal candidate understands that reliable agents at global scale require excellent observability, rigorous evaluation, and a developer experience that makes failures easy to reproduce and fix autonomously through methods like autoresearch. The same harness will power the training and evaluation of new models, creating a tight feedback loop between production experiences and model improvement that is central to Perplexity’s mission.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of experience building and shipping large-scale AI systems and services with high reliability, availability, and performance.

 - Strong software engineering craft, with special care for developer experience and designing future-proof systems that can evolve along with a rapidly advancing AI landscape.

 - Proficiency with Python. Bonus if familiar with Rust and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes).

 - BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent experience)." />

  <meta name="description" content="About Us:

At Parafin, we’re on a mission to grow small businesses.

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but traditional banks often don’t have their backs. We build tech that makes it simple for small businesses to access the financial tools they need through the platforms they already sell on. 

We partner with companies like DoorDash, Amazon, Worldpay, and Mindbody to offer fast and flexible funding, spend management, and savings tools  to their small business users via a simple integration. Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.

We’re a tight-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.


ABOUT THE POSITION

We&#39;re expanding our Partner Engineering team and looking for a Partner Engineer to own the technical experience of our partners after they go live. This is the person who keeps our live integrations healthy, resolves the hardest post-launch technical issues, and—most importantly—builds the tooling, telemetry, and playbooks that let us support a fast-growing base of partners without scaling headcount one-for-one.

It&#39;s a partly partner-facing role that blends hands-on debugging with system-building. You&#39;ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with partners&#39; technical teams and with our own Product and Platform engineers, moving us from reactive, one-off firefighting toward a scalable, self-serve, best-in-class support model. You&#39;ll also be a direct line into Parafin&#39;s product direction: the recurring issues and partner feedback you surface will shape what we build next.

This role reports to the Partner Engineering Manager. We&#39;re hiring across a range of levels—from strong mid-level engineers to senior engineers who have built and scaled support functions before.

Join us and help drive Parafin&#39;s growth.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL BE DOING

Own the health of our live integrations

 - Serve as the ongoing technical point of contact for our partners&#39; engineering teams once they&#39;re live.

 - Proactively monitor integration health, feature adoption, and stability post-launch—catching issues before partners do.

 - Instrument telemetry, logs, and dashboards to observe partner integrations at scale (webhook delivery, disbursement and repayment flows, offer eligibility, reconciliation).

Debug and resolve the hardest technical problems

 - Own escalations end-to-end: reproduce, root-cause, and drive resolution of integration issues, working across Parafin&#39;s codebase (React, Scala, Python) and partner systems.

 - Read logs, write queries, and reproduce issues via API calls to isolate whether a problem lives in our platform, the partner&#39;s implementation, or the data in between.

 - Partner with Product and Platform engineering to ship durable fixes, not just workarounds.

Build a sustainable, scaled support function

 - Design the tooling, automation, and runbooks that turn repeatable integration patterns into self-serve resolution—so we can support the next 10 partners without 10x the effort.

 - Own our technical documentation standards and be the flag-bearer for our public-facing developer docs.

 - Identify recurring issue themes and eliminate their root causes through better tooling, docs, or product changes.

Close the loop with Product and Platform

 - Translate real-world partner needs into prioritized feedback and improvements to our platform, APIs, and partner-facing assets.

 - Advocate for partners internally while diplomatically steering requests toward scalable, supportable solutions.


WHAT WE&#39;RE SEARCHING FOR

 - 3+ years in a client-facing technical role—post-sales / solutions engineering, technical partner support, developer support engineering, or technical account management. Senior candidates who have stood up or scaled a technical support function are especially encouraged to apply.

 - An engineering background, with fluency in one or more languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Scala). You&#39;re comfortable exploring and navigating a production codebase—ours is primarily React, Scala, and Python.

 - Strong hands-on debugging instincts: you can read logs, write SQL, inspect data pipelines, and reproduce issues with API calls to isolate the root cause.

 - Proficiency with integration technologies—REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, data pipelines, and embeddable UI components.

 - Excellent communication skills: you can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, up to and including executives.

 - Strong, partner-focused problem-solving. You have a track record of relentlessly raising the bar for partner experience.

 - A bias toward leverage: you instinctively turn one-off fixes into documentation, tooling, and repeatable process.

 - Ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, adapting quickly as requirements and priorities evolve.

 - Genuine passion for helping small businesses grow and succeed.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another money-movement domain—familiarity with concepts like ledgering and reconciliation is a plus.

 - Familiarity with SQL and with monitoring/observability tooling (dashboards, logging, alerting).

 - Knowledge of industry best practices for integration design and technical scoping.

 - Experience building or improving developer-facing documentation and self-serve support.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Base salary range: $190k - $240k

 - Equity grant

 - Medical, dental &amp; vision insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Commuter benefits

 - Free lunches

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401(k)

 - Employee assistance program

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us." />

This role reports to the Partner Engineering Manager. We&#39;re hiring across a range of levels—from strong mid-level engineers to senior engineers who have built and scaled support functions before.

Join us and help drive Parafin&#39;s growth.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL BE DOING

Own the health of our live integrations

 - Serve as the ongoing technical point of contact for our partners&#39; engineering teams once they&#39;re live.

 - Proactively monitor integration health, feature adoption, and stability post-launch—catching issues before partners do.

 - Instrument telemetry, logs, and dashboards to observe partner integrations at scale (webhook delivery, disbursement and repayment flows, offer eligibility, reconciliation).

Debug and resolve the hardest technical problems

 - Own escalations end-to-end: reproduce, root-cause, and drive resolution of integration issues, working across Parafin&#39;s codebase (React, Scala, Python) and partner systems.

 - Read logs, write queries, and reproduce issues via API calls to isolate whether a problem lives in our platform, the partner&#39;s implementation, or the data in between.

 - Partner with Product and Platform engineering to ship durable fixes, not just workarounds.

Build a sustainable, scaled support function

 - Design the tooling, automation, and runbooks that turn repeatable integration patterns into self-serve resolution—so we can support the next 10 partners without 10x the effort.

 - Own our technical documentation standards and be the flag-bearer for our public-facing developer docs.

 - Identify recurring issue themes and eliminate their root causes through better tooling, docs, or product changes.

Close the loop with Product and Platform

 - Translate real-world partner needs into prioritized feedback and improvements to our platform, APIs, and partner-facing assets.

 - Advocate for partners internally while diplomatically steering requests toward scalable, supportable solutions.


WHAT WE&#39;RE SEARCHING FOR

 - 3+ years in a client-facing technical role—post-sales / solutions engineering, technical partner support, developer support engineering, or technical account management. Senior candidates who have stood up or scaled a technical support function are especially encouraged to apply.

 - An engineering background, with fluency in one or more languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Scala). You&#39;re comfortable exploring and navigating a production codebase—ours is primarily React, Scala, and Python.

 - Strong hands-on debugging instincts: you can read logs, write SQL, inspect data pipelines, and reproduce issues with API calls to isolate the root cause.

 - Proficiency with integration technologies—REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, data pipelines, and embeddable UI components.

 - Excellent communication skills: you can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, up to and including executives.

 - Strong, partner-focused problem-solving. You have a track record of relentlessly raising the bar for partner experience.

 - A bias toward leverage: you instinctively turn one-off fixes into documentation, tooling, and repeatable process.

 - Ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, adapting quickly as requirements and priorities evolve.

 - Genuine passion for helping small businesses grow and succeed.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another money-movement domain—familiarity with concepts like ledgering and reconciliation is a plus.

 - Familiarity with SQL and with monitoring/observability tooling (dashboards, logging, alerting).

 - Knowledge of industry best practices for integration design and technical scoping.

 - Experience building or improving developer-facing documentation and self-serve support.

Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.<br /><br />Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the Position</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're expanding our Partner Engineering team and looking for a <strong>Partner Engineer</strong> to own the technical experience of our partners <em>after</em> they go live. This is the person who keeps our live integrations healthy, resolves the hardest post-launch technical issues, and—most importantly—builds the tooling, telemetry, and playbooks that let us support a fast-growing base of partners without scaling headcount one-for-one.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">It's a partly partner-facing role that blends hands-on debugging with system-building. You'll also be a direct line into Parafin's product direction: the recurring issues and partner feedback you surface will shape what we build next.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role reports to the Partner Engineering Manager.   <meta name="description" content="Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Role:

Skydio is looking for a Director of Product Compliance to own product compliance across our entire portfolio. As our product families and the markets we serve keep expanding, we&#39;re investing in compliance as a core product capability. You&#39;ll build the operating system for it: the policy, the risk framework, the requirements inventory, and the gates that make certification something we design from concept.

You&#39;ll lead a team of portfolio compliance engineers, each owning certification for their programs, and you&#39;ll work across Hardware Ops, Engineering, Product, Security, Supply Chain, Sales, Government, Aviation Regulatory, and Legal to get decisions made. This is a build role with real decision rights, including launch readiness sign-off.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

 - Own product compliance for the company. Set the policy, arbitrate cross-program tradeoffs, own the launch readiness recommendation and sign-off, and act as the single point of accountability when a requirement is contested or a launch is at risk.

 - Lead and grow the compliance team. Develop compliance engineers embedded in program teams, balance their capacity against an 18-month roadmap, and make sure each program has a tailored plan rather than a generic checklist.

 - Chart the path forward in ambiguity. Translate unclear or evolving requirements into a clear compliance strategy, maintaining program momentum and making defensible decisions.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on launch timelines that reflect real certification lead times, dependencies, and external constraints, and escalate launch-critical risk early enough to act on it.

 - Direct our SME bench and external strategy. Get the right experts engaged at the right time across cellular, radio, civil aviation, cybersecurity, supply chain, export, and more, while working with cross functional partners to shape policy and regulation rather than only react to it.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

 - 10+ years in product compliance, certification, or regulatory engineering, including experience leading a team

 - Deep technical grounding across EMC, radio, and product safety, plus enough working knowledge of the adjacent domains — cellular and carrier certification, battery, aviation, cybersecurity, and supply chain and export controls — to know when a requirement applies, which expert to pull in, and whether the answer you&#39;re getting holds up.

 - Track record building process and governance where it didn&#39;t exist, and getting an organization to adopt it

 - Comfortable holding decision rights, including telling a program its launch date is at risk

 - Strong cross-functional operator, effective with engineering, legal, supply chain, and executive stakeholders alike

 - Willingness to work outside the scope of your role to cover gaps in ownership
   

Bonus points if you have:

 - Battery, cellular including PTCRB and MNO, or NRTL compliance experience

 - Familiarity with UAS regulatory frameworks such as FAA, Remote ID, and EASA

 - Experience with federal supply chain, export control, or cybersecurity requirements

 - Regulatory advocacy or standards body engagement experience

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $230,000 - $347,500*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company&#39;s success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

    <title>Production Strategist @ Serval</title><meta name="title" content="Production Strategist @ Serval" />
    
  
  <meta name="description" content="WHO WE ARE

Serval http://serval.com is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Agent Deployment team is a customer-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise-grade features and products. Production Strategists own each customer&#39;s long-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go-live.



ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Production Strategist on Serval&#39;s Agent Deployment team, you&#39;ll be the long-term owner of customer outcomes, making sure the value created at deployment compounds into adoption, expansion, and renewal. You&#39;re the customer&#39;s primary technical partner post-deployment: resolving issues, deepening their use of Serval, and advocating for their needs internally.

What sets this role apart is that you don&#39;t just manage success, you build it. You&#39;ll write code, ship fixes, and create the systems and automation that let us deliver world-class support to more customers without scaling headcount in lockstep. This role is for someone who blends real technical depth with customer obsession and a commercial instinct for what drives retention and growth.

The best Production Strategist leave every customer more self-sufficient, and every process more scalable, than they found it, so that the success of the next ten customers is easier than the last.

 
 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own deployment production success and support: serve as the primary technical resource post-sale, troubleshooting issues, resolving them quickly, and advocating for customer needs internally.

 - Drive renewals and expansion: turn strong adoption into renewals, and surface opportunities to deepen and expand Serval&#39;s footprint within each account.

 - Build systems that scale support: create the tooling, automation, and playbooks that let the team support more customers without scaling headcount linearly.

 - Ship product changes: modify production code to fix bugs and build features that extend Serval&#39;s capabilities to meet customer needs.

 - Make customers self-sufficient: run training sessions and create documentation that help customers get full value from Serval on their own.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Startup experience in a customer-facing or technical role.

 - Strong technical foundation, including the ability to read and troubleshoot production code in customer-facing environments: analyzing code paths, database state, and API requests/responses with infra and browser dev tools.

 - An eagerness to build, writing code and automation to create scalable systems rather than one-off fixes.

 - Excellent communication and relationship-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - An instinct for what drives outcomes (retention, adoption, expansion) with high agency in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
   
    

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in an early-stage startup environment.

 - Experience writing production code or building internal tooling and automation.

 - Experience owning renewals or commercial relationships.

 - Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation.
   
    


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun." />

At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.

We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?


 📍Your Impact Starts Here

We’re looking for a  Project Lead who will own the process of ensuring that our customers are up and running with Homebase Payroll. You will work with small businesses to understand their payroll needs and work closely with sales to gather required information to ensure an accurate and compliant implementation. You will own the onboarding process. You will own this process from start to finish, including helping the customer run their first payroll with Homebase.  You will work in tandem with an Onboarding Implementation Specialist who will be responsible for the technical tasks, along with YTD and Demographic loads.

These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role:

 - Own the end-to-end payroll implementation experience — you&#39;re the customer&#39;s primary point of contact from kickoff through first payroll run, keeping projects on track and on timeline

 - Collect and reconcile complex customer data including business entity details, employee demographics, and YTD payroll records from prior providers

 - Train customers on Homebase Payroll, ensuring they leave onboarding confident and self-sufficient

 - Investigate and resolve customer payroll questions by researching regulations, troubleshooting system issues, and partnering cross-functionally when needed

 - Collaborate with Sales to address implementation blockers that require customer follow-up

 - Surface product feedback and partner with Product and Engineering to improve customer-facing functionality and internal tooling

 - Maintain clean, accurate records in Salesforce throughout every implementation

 - Collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday

 

🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:

 - 3+ years in an Implementation, Onboarding, Payroll, or Project Management role at a SaaS company; payroll implementation experience strongly preferred

 - Proven project management experience managing multiple client engagements simultaneously

 - Advanced in Excel or Google Sheets — you&#39;re comfortable cleaning, reconciling, and working through large data sets

 - Hands-on experience with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), phone systems, and basic technical troubleshooting

 - A clear, confident communicator who can translate complex payroll concepts for customers and internal stakeholders alike

 - A strong problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity, research state-by-state regulations, and find answers independently

 - Energized by complex systems with rules that vary by state, county, and municipality

 - Metrics-driven with a track record of hitting individual and team goals

 - Highly organized with a strong sense of ownership — you drive work to completion and flag risks early

 - 🤖 AI Fluency Expectations (Required) - In this role, you will be expected to:
   
   - Actively use AI tools to improve implementation workflows and operational efficiency.
   
   - Partner with others to test, measure, and refine AI-driven solutions.
   
   - Use data to evaluate AI performance and recommend improvements.
   
   - Continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve.

🤝  The Homie Way - These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.

 - 💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.

 - ⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.

 - 🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.

 - 🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.

 - 🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.

What We Offer 

 - 💰 Ownership &amp; Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match

 - 🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options

 - ⏰ Flexible Time: Unlimited PTO (salaried) + company holidays

 - 🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn&#39;t have a paywall. That means you&#39;ll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.

 - 👶 Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)

 - 🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage

 - 🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

 - 🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, commuter benefits, team offsites, and Customer Days

 - 💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Monday -  Thursday are our required in-office days—a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.

We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?


 📍Your Impact Starts Here

We’re looking for a  Project Lead who will own the process of ensuring that our customers are up and running with Homebase Payroll. You will work with small businesses to understand their payroll needs and work closely with sales to gather required information to ensure an accurate and compliant implementation. You will own the onboarding process. You will own this process from start to finish, including helping the customer run their first payroll with Homebase.  You will work in tandem with an Onboarding Implementation Specialist who will be responsible for the technical tasks, along with YTD and Demographic loads.

These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role:

 - Own the end-to-end payroll implementation experience — you&#39;re the customer&#39;s primary point of contact from kickoff through first payroll run, keeping projects on track and on timeline

 - Collect and reconcile complex customer data including business entity details, employee demographics, and YTD payroll records from prior providers

 - Train customers on Homebase Payroll, ensuring they leave onboarding confident and self-sufficient

 - Investigate and resolve customer payroll questions by researching regulations, troubleshooting system issues, and partnering cross-functionally when needed

 - Collaborate with Sales to address implementation blockers that require customer follow-up

 - Surface product feedback and partner with Product and Engineering to improve customer-facing functionality and internal tooling

 - Maintain clean, accurate records in Salesforce throughout every implementation

 - Collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday

 

🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:

 - 3+ years in an Implementation, Onboarding, Payroll, or Project Management role at a SaaS company; payroll implementation experience strongly preferred

 - Proven project management experience managing multiple client engagements simultaneously

 - Advanced in Excel or Google Sheets — you&#39;re comfortable cleaning, reconciling, and working through large data sets

 - Hands-on experience with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce), phone systems, and basic technical troubleshooting

 - A clear, confident communicator who can translate complex payroll concepts for customers and internal stakeholders alike

 - A strong problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity, research state-by-state regulations, and find answers independently

 - Energized by complex systems with rules that vary by state, county, and municipality

 - Metrics-driven with a track record of hitting individual and team goals

 - Highly organized with a strong sense of ownership — you drive work to completion and flag risks early

 - 🤖 AI Fluency Expectations (Required) - In this role, you will be expected to:
   
   - Actively use AI tools to improve implementation workflows and operational efficiency.
   
   - Partner with others to test, measure, and refine AI-driven solutions.
   
   - Use data to evaluate AI performance and recommend improvements.
   
   - Continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve.

🤝  The Homie Way - These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.

 - 💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.

 - ⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.

 - 🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.

 - 🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.

 - 🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.

What We Offer 

 - 💰 Ownership &amp; Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match

 - 🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options

 - ⏰ Flexible Time: Unlimited PTO (salaried) + company holidays

 - 🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn&#39;t have a paywall. That means you&#39;ll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.

 - 👶 Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)

 - 🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage

 - 🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

 - 🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, commuter benefits, team offsites, and Customer Days

 - 💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Monday -  Thursday are our required in-office days—a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.

What to Expect During the Interview Process 

 - Meet the Talent Acquisition team, Rachel U. https://www.linkedin.com/in/rachelheidiurbelis/

 - Meet the Hiring Manager, Matthew S. https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthewtravisschultz/

 - Participate in a Take-Home Assignment 

 - Onsite Interview in the Denver Office, Matthew S https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthewtravisschultz/ &amp; Alisha H. https://www.linkedin.com/in/alishasholloway/

 - Background Check + Offer Stage

 - Welcome to the team, Homie 🎉
   

💜 Belonging at Homebase - We&#39;re committed to fostering a welcoming space where every Homie can be their full self. Experience comes in many forms—so if you&#39;re excited about this role, even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply! 

👋 Hey, We’re Homebase

Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams—built to simplify the day-to-day and superpower local businesses. With tools for scheduling, time clocks, payroll, communication, HR, and more, we help teams stay connected and in control. Today, over 150,000 small (but mighty) businesses rely on us to make work radically easier. Together, we’ve tracked over a billion hours for 2M+ workers—and we’re just getting started.

At Homebase, we celebrate diversity and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all candidates and do not discriminate based on any legally protected status. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know—we’re committed to ensuring fair and equitable access for all." />

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

YOUR MISSION

This role is dedicated to supporting customers and prospects across our Latin American markets and requires professional fluency in both Portuguese and English.

UiPath is looking for a Business Development Representative to create new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential customers while outbound prospecting with our Enterprise Sales Executives. To be successful in this role, you should have previous experience developing leads from marketing campaigns and prospecting into new accounts.

You will use your communication skills to cultivate meaningful relationships with prospects from first contact to initial conversation across our Latin American markets. If you are motivated, results-driven, and enjoy working in a team environment, we&#39;d like to meet you.

Ultimately, you will boost sales and contribute to our long-term business growth.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Generate qualified meetings for Field Reps through cold calls, emails, and strategic campaigns.

 - Prospect, engage, and build relationships with customers across Latin American markets, communicating effectively in both Portuguese and English.

 - Identify clients&#39; needs and suggest an appropriate solution.

 - Proactively seek new business opportunities in the market.

 - Set up meetings or calls between prospective clients and the Account Executive.

 - Report to the BDR Manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales results.

 - Stay up-to-date with new products/services and our pricing model.

 - Continue to look for ways of incorporating automation into daily work.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Marketing, Sales, Finance, or a related field.

 - 6–12+ months of experience in a sales role (internship experience is counted). 

 - Professional fluency in both Portuguese and English (written and spoken) is required.

 - Experience communicating with customers or prospects across Latin American markets is highly preferred.

 - Ability to deliver engaging presentations.

 - Automation-first mindset.

 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

 - Intermediate to advanced knowledge of MS Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

 - Exposure to or experience with Salesforce is a plus.

About The Role:

 - As a Sales Strategy &amp; Operations Lead within the RevOps function, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure and engine that makes our GTM teams efficiently grow our marketplace. You will work cross-functionally with business operations, finance, and sales and account management leadership to shape our GTM motions, revenue strategy, and workflows. You will implement tools and create processes that are built to scale. This role requires a team player that thrives in a fast-paced environment and is adaptable to change.

 

What You’ll Do

 - Act as a trusted thought partner and advisor to Sales and Revenue executives, specifically working directly with our VP of Supply, Head of Demand Sales, and/or Head of Engagement Management and their frontline managers.

 - Support leadership across annual and quarterly GTM planning, including territory design, capacity planning, quota setting, and forecasting.

 - Calculate attainment and variable compensation, and implement procedures with the Finance team to ensure commissions are paid accurately and on time.

 - Identify leverage points to deploy automation and AI-driven workflows that reduce manual sales and ops work.

 - Drive leadership decision-making through clear analytics and synthesized insights, pushing back on sales leadership when necessary.

 

Required

 - 4-6+ years of experience in RevOps, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, or comparable analytical roles

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

 - Excellent presentation and facilitation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders and employees across the organization

 - Strong program and project management skills

 - Strong Excel skills

 - SQL ability or the willingness to learn to independently query &amp; manipulate data (Metabase)

 - Ability to design systems for executive-level decision-making

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly-growing workplace

 - Based in San Francisco and excited about in-person company culture

Preferred

 - Experience with GTM tools like Apollo, Clay, Gong, Nooks, Unify, Zoominfo

 - Experience with automation tools like Zapier, n8n

 - Experience architecting Salesforce to serve as the control center for a fast-growing, sales-led GTM organization, building and maintaining Flows, Validation Rules, Custom Objects, Reports, and Dashboards.

 - Track record of supporting or partnering closely with senior sales leadership

 - Experience in a high-growth environment or startup


ABOUT PARAFORM:

Paraform is a marketplace modernizing one of the largest and most fragmented markets in the world: hiring. We partner with industry leaders like Decagon, Palantir, Rippling, Abridge, and Hightouch to hire world-class talent, and are growing quickly - 8×-ing revenue last year.

Paraform is the first end-to-end AI recruiting marketplace that connects companies with thousands of specialized recruiters and AI agents that work together to fill roles faster and more accurately.

Our mission is to make hiring fast, reliable, and scalable for every company in the world.

At Paraform, we believe recruiting works best when the right people are working on the right problems, combining human judgment with AI that truly understands hiring. That’s why we’re building a new foundation for how companies hire, bringing together specialized recruiters and modern AI tools.

We treat recruiters like entrepreneurs, not vendors – and we’re building the financial, operational, and technical infrastructure that powers their success.

We are backed by the best investors and technology leaders: Scale, Felicis, A*, BOND, Liquid 2, DST Global, the founders of YouTube, Instacart, Canva, and more." />

    <title>Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform @ Harvey</title><meta name="title" content="Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform @ Harvey" />
    
  
  <meta name="description" content="WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job&#39;s Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we&#39;re never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we&#39;d love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is generating far more data than we currently know how to use well. Product telemetry, agent execution traces, model usage, customer engagement, financial and operational systems — the volume and the number of teams who need to work with it are both growing faster than any single team can serve by hand.

As one of the first hires on our central data platform team, you&#39;ll build the systems that let every team at Harvey work with data confidently and independently. This is a platform charter, not a pipeline queue: you&#39;re building the frameworks, tooling, and paved paths that product engineers, data engineers, and analysts all build on, and you&#39;re measured by their leverage and general trust in our data systems.

The near-term foundation is ingestion and the warehouse — reliable streaming and batch paths into Snowflake, CDC off production systems, orchestration, and schema evolution that absorbs upstream change instead of breaking under it, and factors in the hard data sensitivity requirements our domain requires.

From there the charter expands to the rest of what a modern data platform owes its users: transformation and compute frameworks, self-serve tooling so teams can stand up their own pipelines against well-tested primitives, real-time and stream processing for products and internal systems that can&#39;t wait for a nightly batch, and the quality, lineage, and governance layers that make the whole thing trustworthy. Handling PII correctly and honoring multi-region data residency aren&#39;t nice to have features here — they&#39;re constraints the platform has to satisfy by construction, for customers who are among the most security-conscious institutions in the world.

You&#39;ll sit between Analytics, Data Engineering, product teams, and Infrastructure. Today this work is distributed and improvised. You&#39;ll make it a system, set the technical direction, and help build the team around you.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO

 - Own the data platform&#39;s architecture and technical direction — treating data infrastructure as a software product built from reusable frameworks, and making deliberate build-vs-buy tradeoffs as the platform grows

 - Build and operate the ingestion layer across streaming, batch, CDC, and third-party connectors, including schema evolution that absorbs upstream change safely rather than silently breaking consumers, so onboarding a new source is a paved path instead of a project

 - Land data into Snowflake with the freshness, completeness, and cost characteristics downstream consumers can plan around, and define a clean handoff for Analytics Engineering

 - Own the orchestration platform — scheduling, retries, backfills, and dependency management across the full data graph

 - Build the transformation and compute frameworks teams can use to process data at scale, and the self-serve tooling that lets product engineers and analysts stand up their own pipelines against primitives you&#39;ve already made safe

 - Design and operate stream processing infrastructure for use cases that can&#39;t wait for batch — real-time product features, operational alerting, and near-live reporting

 - Build the trust layer: quality and observability (freshness, validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, alerting routed to the right owner) alongside lineage, cataloging, and discovery, so anyone can find data and know where it came from and what depends on it

 - Build the patterns and tooling for PII and sensitive data — classification, masking, retention, access control — and for multi-region residency requirements

 - Set the technical bar for data at Harvey through design reviews, standards, documentation, and mentorship as the team grows


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years building and operating production data infrastructure, with ownership of systems other teams depend on

 - Deep experience with cloud data warehouses — Snowflake strongly preferred (BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift experience transfers well) — including performance tuning and cost management

 - Hands-on experience building CDC and streaming pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Debezium, Flink, or Spark Streaming

 - Experience with managed ingestion tooling (Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar) and clear judgment about when to buy the connector and when to build it

 - Strong fluency with workflow orchestration — Temporal, Airflow, Dagster, or similar — operated at scale, not just configured

 - Strong programming skills in Python and advanced SQL

 - Experience building frameworks or internal tooling that other engineers use, and the product instinct to know when an abstraction is helping versus getting in the way

 - Practical experience with data quality, observability, and lineage tooling, and with schema evolution in systems that can&#39;t afford downtime

 - Working knowledge of data governance in a regulated environment: PII classification, masking, access control, retention, and data residency

 - Familiarity with cloud data services (Azure, AWS, GCP), Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi)

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and defining scope where none exists


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with dbt and a close working relationship with analytics engineering teams

 - Experience with lakehouse architectures and open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake) or query engines like Trino

 - Experience operating multi-tenant platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements

 - Exposure to data infrastructure for AI products

 - Prior experience as an early or founding data platform hire at a fast-growing company


COMPENSATION

$193,400 - $290,000 USD

From there the charter expands to the rest of what a modern data platform owes its users: transformation and compute frameworks, self-serve tooling so teams can stand up their own pipelines against well-tested primitives, real-time and stream processing for products and internal systems that can&#39;t wait for a nightly batch, and the quality, lineage, and governance layers that make the whole thing trustworthy. Handling PII correctly and honoring multi-region data residency aren&#39;t nice to have features here — they&#39;re constraints the platform has to satisfy by construction, for customers who are among the most security-conscious institutions in the world.

You&#39;ll sit between Analytics, Data Engineering, product teams, and Infrastructure. Today this work is distributed and improvised. You&#39;ll make it a system, set the technical direction, and help build the team around you.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO

 - Own the data platform&#39;s architecture and technical direction — treating data infrastructure as a software product built from reusable frameworks, and making deliberate build-vs-buy tradeoffs as the platform grows

 - Build and operate the ingestion layer across streaming, batch, CDC, and third-party connectors, including schema evolution that absorbs upstream change safely rather than silently breaking consumers, so onboarding a new source is a paved path instead of a project

 - Land data into Snowflake with the freshness, completeness, and cost characteristics downstream consumers can plan around, and define a clean handoff for Analytics Engineering

 - Own the orchestration platform — scheduling, retries, backfills, and dependency management across the full data graph

 - Build the transformation and compute frameworks teams can use to process data at scale, and the self-serve tooling that lets product engineers and analysts stand up their own pipelines against primitives you&#39;ve already made safe

 - Design and operate stream processing infrastructure for use cases that can&#39;t wait for batch — real-time product features, operational alerting, and near-live reporting

 - Build the trust layer: quality and observability (freshness, validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, alerting routed to the right owner) alongside lineage, cataloging, and discovery, so anyone can find data and know where it came from and what depends on it

 - Build the patterns and tooling for PII and sensitive data — classification, masking, retention, access control — and for multi-region residency requirements

 - Set the technical bar for data at Harvey through design reviews, standards, documentation, and mentorship as the team grows


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years building and operating production data infrastructure, with ownership of systems other teams depend on

 - Deep experience with cloud data warehouses — Snowflake strongly preferred (BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift experience transfers well) — including performance tuning and cost management

 - Hands-on experience building CDC and streaming pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Debezium, Flink, or Spark Streaming

 - Experience with managed ingestion tooling (Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar) and clear judgment about when to buy the connector and when to build it

 - Strong fluency with workflow orchestration — Temporal, Airflow, Dagster, or similar — operated at scale, not just configured

 - Strong programming skills in Python and advanced SQL

 - Experience building frameworks or internal tooling that other engineers use, and the product instinct to know when an abstraction is helping versus getting in the way

 - Practical experience with data quality, observability, and lineage tooling, and with schema evolution in systems that can&#39;t afford downtime

 - Working knowledge of data governance in a regulated environment: PII classification, masking, access control, retention, and data residency

 - Familiarity with cloud data services (Azure, AWS, GCP), Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi)

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and defining scope where none exists


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with dbt and a close working relationship with analytics engineering teams

 - Experience with lakehouse architectures and open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake) or query engines like Trino

 - Experience operating multi-tenant platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements

 - Exposure to data infrastructure for AI products

 - Prior experience as an early or founding data platform hire at a fast-growing company


COMPENSATION

$193,400 - $290,000 USD
