Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We&#39;re a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn&#39;t a place to coast. We&#39;re here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you&#39;re looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you&#39;re in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Associate Video Editor at Solace, you&#39;ll help bring our stories to life through thoughtful, high-quality video.

This is a growth-focused role for someone early in their career who is excited to develop their craft alongside experienced editors, producers, and creatives while contributing to meaningful work from day one. You&#39;ll support video projects across a variety of formats, help keep our post-production workflows organized and efficient, and play an important role in managing the growing library of video assets behind our work.

We&#39;re looking for strong creative instincts, exceptional organization, and a genuine love for editing and storytelling.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You&#39;ll Do

 - Edit video content across social, web, marketing, brand, and internal channels

 - Turn raw footage into polished edits, from initial assembly and rough cuts through final exports

 - Support post-production workflows by ingesting footage, syncing audio, organizing project files, and preparing timelines for editors

 - Help maintain and organize Solace&#39;s video assets and Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, including naming conventions, folder structures, metadata, version control, and archival

 - Help ensure footage, project files, and final assets are organized, backed up, searchable, and easily accessible across the team

 - Partner closely with editors, producers, designers, and other creatives throughout the production and post-production process

 - Incorporate creative feedback and revisions quickly and thoughtfully

 - Perform quality control across audio, resolution, formatting, exports, and brand standards before final delivery

 - Continuously improve through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience while helping strengthen our post-production and asset management workflows

What You Bring to the Table

 - 0–2 years of professional, academic, or personal video editing experience. We care more about the quality of your work than your title history.

 - Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software

 - A strong foundation in editing, pacing, visual storytelling, and post-production fundamentals

 - Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail

 - Experience or familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM), media organization, or structured file management

 - Basic understanding of audio editing, color correction, codecs, formats, and video compression

 - Enthusiasm about working on an agile distributed team

 - Solid collaboration and communication skills

 - Curiosity and creativity

 - A genuine appetite for feedback, and the instinct to use critique to sharpen the work

 - A growth mindset, with a drive to keep improving as an editor

 - A portfolio or reel demonstrating video editing ability through professional, academic, or personal work

Experience with After Effects, motion graphics, cloud storage systems, or collaborative post-production workflows is a plus, but not required.

Who We Are

We are a team of ambitious individuals who are passionate about putting healthcare back into the hands of patients. At Solace, you&#39;ll have the opportunity to grow quickly, contribute meaningfully, and build your craft alongside a team that cares deeply about great creative work.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We&#39;re a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Associate Video Editor at Solace, you&#39;ll help bring our stories to life through thoughtful, high-quality video.

This is a growth-focused role for someone early in their career who is excited to develop their craft alongside experienced editors, producers, and creatives while contributing to meaningful work from day one. You&#39;ll support video projects across a variety of formats, help keep our post-production workflows organized and efficient, and play an important role in managing the growing library of video assets behind our work.

We&#39;re looking for strong creative instincts, exceptional organization, and a genuine love for editing and storytelling.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You&#39;ll Do

 - Edit video content across social, web, marketing, brand, and internal channels

 - Turn raw footage into polished edits, from initial assembly and rough cuts through final exports

 - Support post-production workflows by ingesting footage, syncing audio, organizing project files, and preparing timelines for editors

 - Help maintain and organize Solace&#39;s video assets and Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, including naming conventions, folder structures, metadata, version control, and archival

 - Help ensure footage, project files, and final assets are organized, backed up, searchable, and easily accessible across the team

 - Partner closely with editors, producers, designers, and other creatives throughout the production and post-production process

 - Incorporate creative feedback and revisions quickly and thoughtfully

 - Perform quality control across audio, resolution, formatting, exports, and brand standards before final delivery

 - Continuously improve through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience while helping strengthen our post-production and asset management workflows

What You Bring to the Table

 - 0–2 years of professional, academic, or personal video editing experience. We care more about the quality of your work than your title history.

 - Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software

 - A strong foundation in editing, pacing, visual storytelling, and post-production fundamentals

 - Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail

 - Experience or familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM), media organization, or structured file management

 - Basic understanding of audio editing, color correction, codecs, formats, and video compression

 - Enthusiasm about working on an agile distributed team

 - Solid collaboration and communication skills

 - Curiosity and creativity

 - A genuine appetite for feedback, and the instinct to use critique to sharpen the work

 - A growth mindset, with a drive to keep improving as an editor

 - A portfolio or reel demonstrating video editing ability through professional, academic, or personal work

Experience with After Effects, motion graphics, cloud storage systems, or collaborative post-production workflows is a plus, but not required.

Who We Are

We are a team of ambitious individuals who are passionate about putting healthcare back into the hands of patients. At Solace, you&#39;ll have the opportunity to grow quickly, contribute meaningfully, and build your craft alongside a team that cares deeply about great creative work.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Associate Video Editor at Solace, you&#39;ll help bring our stories to life through thoughtful, high-quality video.

This is a growth-focused role for someone early in their career who is excited to develop their craft alongside experienced editors, producers, and creatives while contributing to meaningful work from day one. You&#39;ll support video projects across a variety of formats, help keep our post-production workflows organized and efficient, and play an important role in managing the growing library of video assets behind our work.

We&#39;re looking for strong creative instincts, exceptional organization, and a genuine love for editing and storytelling.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You&#39;ll Do

 - Edit video content across social, web, marketing, brand, and internal channels

 - Turn raw footage into polished edits, from initial assembly and rough cuts through final exports

 - Support post-production workflows by ingesting footage, syncing audio, organizing project files, and preparing timelines for editors

 - Help maintain and organize Solace&#39;s video assets and Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, including naming conventions, folder structures, metadata, version control, and archival

 - Help ensure footage, project files, and final assets are organized, backed up, searchable, and easily accessible across the team

 - Partner closely with editors, producers, designers, and other creatives throughout the production and post-production process

 - Incorporate creative feedback and revisions quickly and thoughtfully

 - Perform quality control across audio, resolution, formatting, exports, and brand standards before final delivery

 - Continuously improve through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience while helping strengthen our post-production and asset management workflows

What You Bring to the Table

 - 0–2 years of professional, academic, or personal video editing experience. We care more about the quality of your work than your title history.

 - Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software

 - A strong foundation in editing, pacing, visual storytelling, and post-production fundamentals

 - Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail

 - Experience or familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM), media organization, or structured file management

 - Basic understanding of audio editing, color correction, codecs, formats, and video compression

 - Enthusiasm about working on an agile distributed team

 - Solid collaboration and communication skills

 - Curiosity and creativity

 - A genuine appetite for feedback, and the instinct to use critique to sharpen the work

 - A growth mindset, with a drive to keep improving as an editor

 - A portfolio or reel demonstrating video editing ability through professional, academic, or personal work

Experience with After Effects, motion graphics, cloud storage systems, or collaborative post-production workflows is a plus, but not required.

Who We Are

We are a team of ambitious individuals who are passionate about putting healthcare back into the hands of patients. At Solace, you&#39;ll have the opportunity to grow quickly, contribute meaningfully, and build your craft alongside a team that cares deeply about great creative work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you a new grad who wants to build something that matters from day one? At Solace, you won&#39;t be relegated to small bug fixes or endless onboarding—you&#39;ll ship real features to real users within your first weeks. This isn&#39;t a hand-holding job. You&#39;ll be challenged daily, expected to move fast, learn faster, and take ownership of your work like a seasoned engineer.

You&#39;ll join a spectacularly talented team who will push you to grow, but you&#39;ll also be expected to think independently, ask the right questions, and own your work from design through deployment. You will commit code daily. You will make mistakes. You will learn from them and get better every single day. If you&#39;re the kind of person who wants to be thrown into the deep end and come out stronger, keep reading.

You are scrappy, resourceful, and eager to prove yourself. You don&#39;t need all the answers—you need the drive to find them. You&#39;re not afraid of ambiguity or hard problems; in fact, they excite you. You take feedback like fuel, and you&#39;re looking for a place that will invest in making you exceptional, not comfortable.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You&#39;ll Do

 - Ship production code in your first week—real features that impact real users.

 - Build across the stack, from database queries to API endpoints to UI components, learning the full lifecycle of software development.

 - Take ownership of features end-to-end. You&#39;ll be accountable for what you build, and you&#39;ll feel the weight and pride of that responsibility.

 - Work directly with senior engineers, product managers, and designers. You&#39;ll have mentorship, but you&#39;ll also be expected to drive your own work forward.

 - Debug production issues, refactor messy code, and improve systems—not glamorous, but essential, and you&#39;ll learn more from this than any bootcamp could teach you.

 - Move fast and iterate. We deploy continuously, and you&#39;ll see your code in production within hours, not weeks.

 - Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and product planning. Your voice matters here, even on day one.

What You Bring to the Table

 - A bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)—graduating between December 2026 and June 2027.

 - Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and software design.

 - Experience with at least one modern programming language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, etc.). Bonus if you&#39;ve worked with TypeScript, React, or Node.js.

 - Projects that show you can build real things—personal projects, hackathons, internships, open source contributions. We care about what you&#39;ve shipped, not just what you studied.

 - A hunger to learn and an ego small enough to admit when you don&#39;t know something.

 - Grit. You don&#39;t give up when things get hard. You Google, you ask questions, you figure it out.

 - Strong communication skills. You can explain your thinking, take feedback without defensiveness, and collaborate with people who aren&#39;t engineers.

 - Extreme bias toward action. You&#39;d rather ship something imperfect and iterate than wait for perfect.

What You&#39;ll Learn

You&#39;ll be working in our modern tech stack and will gain hands-on experience with:

 - We use Typescript across all our applications and throughout our interview process

 - NestJS API with TypeORM

 - Postgres and Redis

 - React with our custom UI library built on shadcn

 - Tailwind CSS

Although our engineers use AI tools daily as part of our development workflow, we do not permit the use of AI tools during our interview process

Why Join as a New Grad?

Most companies will have you shadow people for six months. We&#39;ll have you shipping code in weeks. Most companies will give you toy projects. We&#39;ll give you real problems that matter. You&#39;ll grow faster here in one year than you would in three years at a big tech company. It will be hard. You will struggle. And you will come out the other side a dramatically better engineer.

This is not a job for someone looking for work-life balance metrics or a gentle onboarding process. This is for the new grad who wants to prove they can compete with engineers who have years of experience. If that&#39;s you, we can&#39;t wait to meet you.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

 - Debug production issues, refactor messy code, and improve systems—not glamorous, but essential, and you&#39;ll learn more from this than any bootcamp could teach you.

 - Move fast and iterate. We deploy continuously, and you&#39;ll see your code in production within hours, not weeks.

 - Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and product planning. Your voice matters here, even on day one.

What You Bring to the Table

 - A bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)—graduating between December 2026 and June 2027.

 - Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and software design.

 - Experience with at least one modern programming language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, etc.). Bonus if you&#39;ve worked with TypeScript, React, or Node.js.

 - Projects that show you can build real things—personal projects, hackathons, internships, open source contributions. We care about what you&#39;ve shipped, not just what you studied.

 - A hunger to learn and an ego small enough to admit when you don&#39;t know something.

 - Grit. You don&#39;t give up when things get hard. You Google, you ask questions, you figure it out.

 - Strong communication skills. You can explain your thinking, take feedback without defensiveness, and collaborate with people who aren&#39;t engineers.

 - Extreme bias toward action. You&#39;d rather ship something imperfect and iterate than wait for perfect.

What You&#39;ll Learn

You&#39;ll be working in our modern tech stack and will gain hands-on experience with:

 - We use Typescript across all our applications and throughout our interview process

 - NestJS API with TypeORM

 - Postgres and Redis

 - React with our custom UI library built on shadcn

 - Tailwind CSS

Although our engineers use AI tools daily as part of our development workflow, we do not permit the use of AI tools during our interview process

Why Join as a New Grad?

Most companies will have you shadow people for six months. We&#39;ll have you shipping code in weeks. Most companies will give you toy projects. We&#39;ll give you real problems that matter. You&#39;ll grow faster here in one year than you would in three years at a big tech company. It will be hard. You will struggle. And you will come out the other side a dramatically better engineer.

This is not a job for someone looking for work-life balance metrics or a gentle onboarding process. This is for the new grad who wants to prove they can compete with engineers who have years of experience. If that&#39;s you, we can&#39;t wait to meet you.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Brand Marketing Associate at Solace, you’ll help turn marketing ideas into campaigns that reach patients and families. This role is designed for a recent graduate who wants hands-on experience across brand, creative, campaign operations, and go-to-market execution.

You won&#39;t be expected to arrive with years of marketing experience. You will be expected to be organized, curious, responsive to feedback, and willing to jump into the details. You&#39;ll work closely with experienced marketers and cross-functional partners while contributing to real campaigns from day one.

This is a strong fit for someone who likes making things happen: building a clean tracker, catching a missing detail before launch, turning feedback into an updated brief, and keeping a fast-moving project on track.

This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO


CAMPAIGN EXECUTION &amp; COORDINATION

 - Help keep campaign timelines, workback plans, launch checklists, and deliverable trackers accurate and up to date.

 - Support campaign briefs by organizing objectives, audiences, messaging inputs, channel requirements, and creative specifications.

 - Coordinate creative review rounds, consolidate feedback, track revisions, and make sure the right stakeholders see the right version.

 - Follow up on open deliverables and flag missing information, delays, or blockers early.

 - QA links, copy, assets, naming, and basic launch details before campaigns go live.


MARKETING OPERATIONS

 - Maintain marketing budget trackers, expense sheets, invoice logs, and other team documentation with a high level of accuracy.

 - Help coordinate vendor and agency invoice intake with Accounting and keep supporting documentation organized.

 - Keep campaign folders, Notion pages, briefs, and shared resources organized so the team can quickly find what it needs.

 - Take clear notes, capture decisions and owners, and make sure follow-ups do not get lost.


GTM, RESEARCH &amp; CHANNEL SUPPORT

 - Support go-to-market planning and internal launch readiness for new campaigns and marketing initiatives.

 - Research competitors, audiences, cultural moments, emerging channels, and campaign examples to help the team develop stronger ideas.

 - Assist with emerging channels such as TikTok and Snapchat by organizing assets, tracking tests, and documenting learnings.

 - Pull basic campaign results and help turn them into clear recaps of what launched, what happened, and what the team should learn next.

 - Help route patient-facing marketing materials through the appropriate internal review process and make sure approved changes are reflected before launch.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, campus organizations, student agencies, freelance work, part-time jobs, class projects, and personal side projects all count.

 - Strong organizational skills and genuine satisfaction from keeping details, deadlines, and documentation in order.

 - Clear written communication and the ability to turn a messy set of inputs into something easy for others to follow.

 - Comfort with spreadsheets, shared documents, and project-management tools, or the ability to learn them quickly.

 - Curiosity about why marketing works and an interest in learning across brand, creative, performance, and growth.

 - A proactive mindset. When something is unclear or missing, you ask, investigate, and help move it forward.

 - Strong attention to detail, especially when work is patient-facing or requires careful review.

 - An appetite for feedback and the ability to apply it quickly without getting stuck on having the first version be perfect.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change and everyone is expected to contribute.


WHAT WOULD SET YOU APART

 - A portfolio, class project, student organization, internship, or side project where you helped market something and can explain what you actually did.

 - Experience creating or supporting content for TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, YouTube, newsletters, or other digital channels.

 - Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, Canva, or similar tools.

 - Interest in healthcare, consumer technology, or mission-driven companies.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

          // preload silently bypasses the SRI check on the entry bundle.
          preload.setAttribute("integrity", indexData.integrity);
          preload.setAttribute("crossorigin", "");
          document.head.appendChild(preload);
        } else {
          loadBundle();
        }
    
        if (indexData.imports != null && indexData.imports.length > 0) {
          indexData.imports.forEach(function (file) {
            const preload = document.createElement("link");
            preload.rel = "modulepreload";
            preload.href = "https://cdn.ashbyprd.com/frontend_non_user/9d2556759f97ad8e8df1f95c766ce791002e553a/" + manifest[file].file;
            // Without integrity here SRI is never enforced on the code-split
            // chunks (the bulk of the app), in any browser.
            preload.setAttribute("integrity", manifest[file].integrity);
            preload.setAttribute("crossorigin", "");
            document.head.appendChild(preload);
          });
        }
      });
    </script>  </body>
</html>

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Influencer Marketing Associate at Solace, you&#39;ll help the team find great creators, build strong working relationships, and keep influencer campaigns moving from outreach through launch and reporting. This is an early-career role for a recent graduate who understands internet culture, communicates well, and is excited to learn how creator marketing works behind the scenes.

You don&#39;t need years of agency or talent-management experience. You do need strong judgment, excellent follow-through, and genuine curiosity about creators and the communities they build. You&#39;ll learn from experienced marketers while taking on meaningful execution work from day one.

Because Solace works in healthcare, you&#39;ll also learn how to create compelling marketing while handling patient stories, claims, disclosures, approvals, and sensitive information with care.

This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO


CREATOR RESEARCH &amp; OUTREACH

 - Research creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, and other emerging channels based on audience fit, content quality, credibility, and campaign goals.

 - Build creator shortlists and organize relevant information such as audience, content style, contact details, prior partnerships, and performance signals.

 - Support creator outreach using approved messaging and keep responses, follow-ups, and next steps organized.

 - Stay close to creator culture and surface new voices, formats, trends, and conversations that may be relevant to Solace.


CAMPAIGN COORDINATION

 - Help turn campaign strategy into clear creator briefs, timelines, deliverable lists, and launch trackers.

 - Coordinate scheduling, content submissions, review rounds, approvals, and go-live dates across multiple creators.

 - Maintain accurate records for contracts, usage rights, deliverables, payment status, contact history, and campaign notes.

 - Perform an initial check of submitted content against the brief, required disclosures, format requirements, and approved messaging before escalating for final review.

 - Flag missed deadlines, unclear deliverables, or other campaign risks early and help the team resolve them.


PERFORMANCE &amp; TEAM SUPPORT

 - Pull basic campaign metrics and organize results so the team can see which creators, messages, and formats are performing.

 - Help prepare campaign recaps and document learnings for future creator selection and briefs.

 - Keep the influencer roster, campaign trackers, folders, and Notion pages clean and current.

 - Coordinate with brand, creative, performance, partnerships, legal, and compliance teams when campaigns require additional review or support.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, student organizations, your own content, freelance projects, campus ambassador work, talent or entertainment experience, and side projects all count.

 - You are genuinely interested in creators, social platforms, digital culture, and why certain content earns trust and attention.

 - You are highly organized and can keep many small details moving without losing track of deadlines.

 - You write clear, warm, professional messages and understand that every creator interaction represents the Solace brand.

 - You have good judgment and know when to move something forward independently versus when to ask for help.

 - You take feedback well, make changes quickly, and do not get defensive when a first draft needs work.

 - You are comfortable working quickly while being thoughtful about healthcare claims, patient privacy, and sensitive stories.

 - You are resourceful. If you do not know how to find a creator, organize a process, or solve a small operational problem, your instinct is to figure it out.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - A strong point of view on social media and creators, even if your experience comes from school, internships, personal projects, or your own online presence.

 - Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, Airtable, creator-management tools, or similar systems is helpful but not required.

 - Any experience with creator outreach, campus ambassadors, social content, talent coordination, PR, events, or community management.

 - Interest in healthcare, wellness, consumer technology, or mission-driven storytelling.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Partnership Marketing Associate at Solace, you&#39;ll help turn signed partnerships into organized, high-quality marketing activations that reach more patients and strengthen the Solace brand. This is an early-career role for a recent graduate who is interested in the mix of relationship building, marketing execution, project coordination, and business growth.

You&#39;ll work closely with the Senior Partnership Marketing Manager and learn how different types of partners are activated, from organizations that can introduce Solace to new patient populations to partners that build credibility and awareness. Your job is not to arrive as a seasoned partnership strategist. Your job is to make the details work: keep plans organized, communicate clearly, follow through, and help every activation move forward.

You&#39;ll gain exposure to external partners as well as internal teams including brand, performance, creative, PR, analytics, legal, and compliance.

This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO


PARTNER ACTIVATION &amp; CAMPAIGN SUPPORT

 - Maintain partner marketing calendars, activation trackers, workback plans, and deliverable lists so commitments are visible and on time.

 - Help turn partnership goals and signed commitments into clear internal briefs, asset requests, timelines, and next steps.

 - Coordinate co-branded campaigns across channels such as email, paid media, social, content, events, PR, and partner-owned channels.

 - Track asset creation, feedback, approvals, and handoffs between Solace and partner teams.

 - Keep playbooks, templates, partner folders, and campaign documentation organized and current.


PARTNER COORDINATION

 - Support day-to-day partner communication under the guidance of the Partnership Marketing Manager.

 - Prepare agendas, take clear notes, capture owners and deadlines, and send or draft follow-ups after partner meetings.

 - Coordinate scheduling, asset exchanges, launch dates, and routine requests with partner marketing teams.

 - Flag missing information, delays, or risks early so the team can solve them before they affect a launch.

 - Help research partner audiences, comparable activations, and new co-marketing ideas when the team is planning a campaign.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL &amp; COMPLIANCE SUPPORT

 - Coordinate with brand, creative, performance, PR, and analytics teams to keep partner activations aligned and moving.

 - Help route co-marketing materials through legal and compliance review when needed and make sure approved changes are incorporated before launch.

 - Maintain a clear record of approved assets, messaging, and deliverables for each partnership.


TRACKING &amp; REPORTING

 - Pull basic campaign and partner performance data using established team dashboards and trackers.

 - Help prepare partner recaps that summarize what launched, key results, open follow-ups, and learnings.

 - Track agreed success metrics such as traffic, patient volume, acquisition efficiency, engagement, or brand impact depending on the partnership.

 - Help document what worked so future partner activations become faster and more repeatable.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, campus organizations, sponsorships, events, student consulting, account-management projects, freelance work, and side projects all count.

 - Excellent organization and follow-through. You like keeping commitments, owners, dates, and details in one clear place.

 - Strong written communication and the ability to draft concise, professional emails, updates, agendas, and recaps.

 - High emotional intelligence and a natural instinct to be thoughtful, responsive, and reliable with other people.

 - Comfort interacting with external partners while knowing when to pull in a more senior team member.

 - Attention to detail and good judgment, especially when coordinating co-branded work in healthcare.

 - Curiosity about how partnerships can drive both growth and brand trust.

 - A proactive, resourceful mindset. You do not wait for someone to chase you for an update or remind you about a follow-up.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where plans evolve and priorities may shift.


WHAT WOULD SET YOU APART

 - Experience supporting sponsorships, partnerships, campus events, clubs, fundraising, account management, or external relationships.

 - A project where you coordinated several people or organizations toward a shared deadline and can explain how you kept it organized.

 - Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, project-management tools, or marketing analytics.

 - Interest in healthcare, mission-driven companies, or regulated industries.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Performance Marketing Associate at Solace, you&#39;ll learn how a high-growth marketing team acquires patients, measures performance, and improves campaigns across paid media channels. This is a hands-on role for a recent graduate who is curious about the intersection of marketing, data, creative, and technology.

You&#39;ll work alongside experienced performance marketers and support the details that make campaigns successful: clean setup, accurate tracking, organized assets, careful QA, pacing, reporting, and follow-through. You do not need to arrive knowing every advertising platform. You do need to be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn quickly, and relentless about accuracy.

You&#39;ll get exposure to channels that may include paid social, search, display, video, CTV, podcasts, streaming audio, direct mail, out-of-home, and other growth experiments.

This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO


CAMPAIGN SETUP &amp; QA

 - Support campaign launches by organizing briefs, channel specs, creative files, audiences, links, and tracking requirements.

 - Assist with campaign setup and perform structured QA under the guidance of the performance team, checking targeting, budgets, creative, landing pages, naming, and tracking before launch.

 - Maintain campaign calendars and launch trackers so owners, deadlines, and dependencies are clear.

 - Traffic creative assets and keep version control clean across platforms, agencies, and internal teams.


MEASUREMENT &amp; REPORTING

 - Build and QA UTMs and other campaign tracking inputs using established team processes.

 - Pull recurring performance data and help maintain pacing sheets, dashboards, and campaign reports.

 - Monitor basic metrics such as spend, clicks, conversion rate, booking volume, and acquisition efficiency, and flag unusual changes for the team to investigate.

 - Help document experiments and summarize what changed, what happened, and what the team learned.

 - Support landing-page and funnel testing by maintaining test logs, checking implementation, and organizing results.


CREATIVE, AGENCY &amp; CROSS-FUNCTIONAL SUPPORT

 - Partner with creative and brand teams to make sure paid media assets meet channel requirements and arrive on time.

 - Help organize creative-performance learnings so the team can identify which messages, formats, and audiences are working.

 - Coordinate with agencies and vendors on routine deliverables, reporting needs, asset requests, and follow-ups.

 - Work with product, analytics, and other teams to surface tracking or funnel issues and keep open questions moving toward resolution.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, coursework, student consulting, freelance work, paid-media projects, analytics projects, and personal side projects all count.

 - Comfort working with numbers and spreadsheets. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you should enjoy finding patterns and checking whether the numbers make sense.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and the patience to QA work before it goes live.

 - Curiosity about digital advertising, growth, consumer behavior, experimentation, and how marketing turns into measurable business results.

 - Strong organization and follow-through across multiple small tasks and deadlines.

 - Clear communication and the confidence to flag when something looks wrong or does not make sense.

 - A growth mindset and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools, platforms, and concepts quickly.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Performance Marketing Associate at Solace, you&#39;ll learn how a high-growth marketing team acquires patients, measures performance, and improves campaigns across paid media channels. This is a hands-on role for a recent graduate who is curious about the intersection of marketing, data, creative, and technology.

You&#39;ll work alongside experienced performance marketers and support the details that make campaigns successful: clean setup, accurate tracking, organized assets, careful QA, pacing, reporting, and follow-through. You do not need to arrive knowing every advertising platform. You do need to be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn quickly, and relentless about accuracy.

You&#39;ll get exposure to channels that may include paid social, search, display, video, CTV, podcasts, streaming audio, direct mail, out-of-home, and other growth experiments.

This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO


CAMPAIGN SETUP &amp; QA

 - Support campaign launches by organizing briefs, channel specs, creative files, audiences, links, and tracking requirements.

 - Assist with campaign setup and perform structured QA under the guidance of the performance team, checking targeting, budgets, creative, landing pages, naming, and tracking before launch.

 - Maintain campaign calendars and launch trackers so owners, deadlines, and dependencies are clear.

 - Traffic creative assets and keep version control clean across platforms, agencies, and internal teams.


MEASUREMENT &amp; REPORTING

 - Build and QA UTMs and other campaign tracking inputs using established team processes.

 - Pull recurring performance data and help maintain pacing sheets, dashboards, and campaign reports.

 - Monitor basic metrics such as spend, clicks, conversion rate, booking volume, and acquisition efficiency, and flag unusual changes for the team to investigate.

 - Help document experiments and summarize what changed, what happened, and what the team learned.

 - Support landing-page and funnel testing by maintaining test logs, checking implementation, and organizing results.


CREATIVE, AGENCY &amp; CROSS-FUNCTIONAL SUPPORT

 - Partner with creative and brand teams to make sure paid media assets meet channel requirements and arrive on time.

 - Help organize creative-performance learnings so the team can identify which messages, formats, and audiences are working.

 - Coordinate with agencies and vendors on routine deliverables, reporting needs, asset requests, and follow-ups.

 - Work with product, analytics, and other teams to surface tracking or funnel issues and keep open questions moving toward resolution.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, coursework, student consulting, freelance work, paid-media projects, analytics projects, and personal side projects all count.

 - Comfort working with numbers and spreadsheets. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you should enjoy finding patterns and checking whether the numbers make sense.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and the patience to QA work before it goes live.

 - Curiosity about digital advertising, growth, consumer behavior, experimentation, and how marketing turns into measurable business results.

 - Strong organization and follow-through across multiple small tasks and deadlines.

 - Clear communication and the confidence to flag when something looks wrong or does not make sense.

 - A growth mindset and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools, platforms, and concepts quickly.

 - A bias toward action balanced with care around data quality, patient-facing experiences, and regulated healthcare marketing.


WHAT WOULD SET YOU APART

 - Hands-on exposure to Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, GA4, Looker, Tableau, or another analytics or advertising platform through an internship, class, certification, or personal project.

 - A project where you used data to make a recommendation and can explain your reasoning.

 - Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills.

 - Interest in healthcare, consumer technology, or high-growth startups.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare chance to learn product management from the inside out at one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the country. As an Associate Product Manager at Solace, you’ll help shape how millions of people experience healthcare while working side-by-side with designers, engineers, clinicians, and product leaders.

Your job is to help us make healthcare feel human again. You’ll research, organize, and test ideas, build new features, and help us launch faster. You don’t need years of experience, but you do need an innate ability to get things done.

This role is for the ambitious, the curious and those who don&#39;t shy away from feedback. If you’re the kind of person who sees a problem and can’t resist solving it, keep reading.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You’ll Do

 - Learn what great Product looks like directly from people doing it every day.

 - Bring bold ideas and (occasionally) watch them get destroyed in the name of better ones.

 - Rapidly produce and launch concepts while laughing in the face of potential failure.

 - Partner with engineers, designers, and clinicians to deliver meaningful improvements for patients and advocates.

 - Keep projects moving forward, make sure deadlines are hit, and translate chaos into constant clarity.

 - Test, document, and ship features that make Solace better every week.

 - Grow your craft: learn how to write specs, analyze data, talk to users, and make smart product decisions.

What You Bring to the Table

 - A bias toward action. You have an exceptional craving for momentum, and you thrive on timelines that would be unrealistic for most others. You want to build things and learn fast.

 - Curiosity for how systems work.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a refined palate for controlled chaos.

 - Unfettered creativity paired with confident communication. You can explain your thinking simply.

 - A sense of care. You take pride in the details.

 - Bonus: Experience working on projects, internships, or student teams where you had to organize, lead or ship something real.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare chance to learn product management from the inside out at one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the country. As an Associate Product Manager at Solace, you’ll help shape how millions of people experience healthcare while working side-by-side with designers, engineers, clinicians, and product leaders.

Your job is to help us make healthcare feel human again. You’ll research, organize, and test ideas, build new features, and help us launch faster. You don’t need years of experience, but you do need an innate ability to get things done.

This role is for the ambitious, the curious and those who don&#39;t shy away from feedback. If you’re the kind of person who sees a problem and can’t resist solving it, keep reading.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You’ll Do

 - Learn what great Product looks like directly from people doing it every day.

 - Bring bold ideas and (occasionally) watch them get destroyed in the name of better ones.

 - Rapidly produce and launch concepts while laughing in the face of potential failure.

 - Partner with engineers, designers, and clinicians to deliver meaningful improvements for patients and advocates.

 - Keep projects moving forward, make sure deadlines are hit, and translate chaos into constant clarity.

 - Test, document, and ship features that make Solace better every week.

 - Grow your craft: learn how to write specs, analyze data, talk to users, and make smart product decisions.

What You Bring to the Table

 - A bias toward action. You have an exceptional craving for momentum, and you thrive on timelines that would be unrealistic for most others. You want to build things and learn fast.

 - Curiosity for how systems work.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a refined palate for controlled chaos.

 - Unfettered creativity paired with confident communication. You can explain your thinking simply.

 - A sense of care. You take pride in the details.

 - Bonus: Experience working on projects, internships, or student teams where you had to organize, lead or ship something real.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

        if (indexData.imports != null && indexData.imports.length > 0) {
          indexData.imports.forEach(function (file) {
            const preload = document.createElement("link");
            preload.rel = "modulepreload";
            preload.href = "https://cdn.ashbyprd.com/frontend_non_user/9d2556759f97ad8e8df1f95c766ce791002e553a/" + manifest[file].file;
            // Without integrity here SRI is never enforced on the code-split
            // chunks (the bulk of the app), in any browser.
            preload.setAttribute("integrity", manifest[file].integrity);
            preload.setAttribute("crossorigin", "");
            document.head.appendChild(preload);
          });
        }
      });

  <meta name="description" content="ABOUT SOLACE

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We&#39;re a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn&#39;t a place to coast. We&#39;re here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you&#39;re looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you&#39;re in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

About the Role

As a Sr. Associate Product Manager at Solace, you will be responsible for developing and executing product initiatives that drive positive customer perception, experience, and retention. You are a self-starter interested in working on a broad set of in-house initiatives and taking on significant direct ownership responsibility.

The Sr. Associate Product Manager is responsible for supporting engineering, design and product management across Solace’s products.

This individual contributor role is for the ambitious, the curious and those who don&#39;t shy away from feedback. Hunger, and a desire to dedicate yourself fully to the mission is essential. You will report directly to one of our Product Managers.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.

What You’ll Do

 - Bring innovative Product ideas—and bring them to life.

 - Be autonomous. You’ll take full ownership of your work, and you take responsibility for every last detail, every step of the way.

 - Rapidly produce and launch concepts while laughing in the face of potential failure.

 - Serve as the go-to liaison with cross-functional and creative partners. Define initiative-level roadmaps of supporting workstreams to ensure work delivers on goals and your deadlines are met.

 - Provide up-to-date visibility into current projects and ensure the right stakeholders and cross-functional team members are involved at the right time. You’ll document decisions and action items and follow up with owners on commitments.

 - Learn and become a guardian of the Solace brand and user expectations, upholding standards and best practices across every touchpoint.

What You Bring to the Table

 - A bias toward action and execution. You have an exceptional craving for momentum, and you thrive on timelines that would be unrealistic for most others.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a refined palate for controlled chaos.

 - Unfettered creativity.

 - Intuition on what it takes to create delightful, consumer-oriented experiences to not only acquire customers, but retain them.

 - Great communication skills that help you work across departments to make marketing visions come to life.

Who We Are

We are a team of ambitious individuals who are passionate about putting healthcare back into the hands of patients. At Solace, you will have a steep learning curve and an unparalleled opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the U.S. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We&#39;re a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn&#39;t a place to coast. We&#39;re here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you&#39;re looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you&#39;re in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you a new grad who wants to defend something that matters from day one? As an Associate Security Engineer, you won&#39;t be relegated to ticket triage or endless compliance checklists. You&#39;ll be doing real security work that protects real patient data within your first weeks. This isn&#39;t a hand-holding job. You&#39;ll be challenged daily, expected to move fast, learn faster, and take ownership of your work like a seasoned engineer.

You&#39;ll join a small, security team that built this program from scratch. We will push you to grow, but you&#39;ll also be expected to think independently, ask the right questions, and own your work from start to finish.

You are scrappy, resourceful, and eager to prove yourself. You don&#39;t need all the answers; you need the drive to find them. You&#39;re not afraid of ambiguity or hard problems; in fact, they excite you. You take feedback like fuel, and you&#39;re looking for a place that will invest in making you exceptional, not comfortable.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO

 - Do real security work in your first week: no shadowing period, no toy projects.

 - Rotate across the full breadth of a security program: incident response, cloud security, identity and access management, endpoint security, application security, vendor reviews, and compliance engineering. You&#39;ll find out what you&#39;re great at by doing all of it.

 - Take ownership of projects end-to-end. You&#39;ll be accountable for what you find and fix, and you&#39;ll feel the weight and pride of that responsibility.

 - Work directly with senior security engineers, platform engineers, and compliance. You&#39;ll have mentorship, but you&#39;ll also be expected to drive your own work forward.

 - Investigate incidents, review access, harden systems, and close out risks. Not glamorous, but essential, and you&#39;ll learn more from this than any certification could teach you.

 - Automate the boring stuff. If you do something twice by hand, we expect you to script it the third time.

 - Participate in incident reviews, vendor security reviews, and risk discussions. Your voice matters here, even on day one.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - A bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience), graduating between December 2026 and June 2027.

 - Solid fundamentals in networking, operating systems, and how the web actually works (HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication).

 - Scripting ability in at least one language (Python, TypeScript, Bash, etc.). You don&#39;t need to be a software engineer, but you need to be able to read code and write automation.

 - Evidence you can actually do security: CTFs, home labs, security projects, internships, bug bounty submissions, open source contributions. We care about what you&#39;ve broken and fixed, not just what you studied.

 - A hunger to learn and an ego small enough to admit when you don&#39;t know something.

 - Grit. You don&#39;t give up when things get hard. You Google, you read the docs, you ask questions, you figure it out.

 - Strong communication skills. You can explain a finding to an engineer, take feedback without defensiveness, and translate risk for people who aren&#39;t technical.

 - Sound judgment and discretion. We&#39;re a healthcare company handling protected health information, and you&#39;ll be trusted with sensitive access and sensitive situations.

 - Extreme bias toward action. You&#39;d rather ship something imperfect and iterate than wait for perfect.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL LEARN

You&#39;ll get hands-on experience across every domain of a modern security program:

 - Incident response and investigations

 - Cloud security across AWS and GCP

 - Identity and access management (Okta, Google Workspace)

 - Security monitoring and detection

 - Endpoint and corporate security

 - Application and product security

 - HIPAA compliance and security automation


WHY JOIN AS A NEW GRAD?

Most companies will pigeonhole you into one narrow function for years. Here you&#39;ll touch every part of a security program and figure out where you shine. Most companies will give you canned training scenarios. We&#39;ll give you real incidents, real systems, and real patient data to protect. You&#39;ll grow faster here in one year than you would in three years at a big company. It will be hard. You will struggle. And you will come out the other side a dramatically better security engineer.

This is not a job for someone looking for a gentle onboarding process. This is for the new grad who wants to prove they can hang with engineers who have years of experience. If that&#39;s you, we can&#39;t wait to meet you.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

Most companies will pigeonhole you into one narrow function for years. Here you&#39;ll touch every part of a security program and figure out where you shine. Most companies will give you canned training scenarios. We&#39;ll give you real incidents, real systems, and real patient data to protect. You&#39;ll grow faster here in one year than you would in three years at a big company. It will be hard. You will struggle. And you will come out the other side a dramatically better security engineer.

This is not a job for someone looking for a gentle onboarding process. This is for the new grad who wants to prove they can hang with engineers who have years of experience. If that&#39;s you, we can&#39;t wait to meet you.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We&#39;re a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn&#39;t a place to coast. We&#39;re here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you&#39;re looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you&#39;re in the right place. ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you a new grad who wants to defend something that matters from day one? As an Associate Security Engineer, you won&#39;t be relegated to ticket triage or endless compliance checklists. You&#39;ll be doing real security work that protects real patient data within your first weeks. This isn&#39;t a hand-holding job. You&#39;ll be challenged daily, expected to move fast, learn faster, and take ownership of your work like a seasoned engineer.

You&#39;ll join a small, security team that built this program from scratch. We will push you to grow, but you&#39;ll also be expected to think independently, ask the right questions, and own your work from start to finish.

You are scrappy, resourceful, and eager to prove yourself. You don&#39;t need all the answers; you need the drive to find them. You&#39;re not afraid of ambiguity or hard problems; in fact, they excite you. You take feedback like fuel, and you&#39;re looking for a place that will invest in making you exceptional, not comfortable.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL DO

 - Do real security work in your first week: no shadowing period, no toy projects.

 - Rotate across the full breadth of a security program: incident response, cloud security, identity and access management, endpoint security, application security, vendor reviews, and compliance engineering. You&#39;ll find out what you&#39;re great at by doing all of it.

 - Take ownership of projects end-to-end. You&#39;ll be accountable for what you find and fix, and you&#39;ll feel the weight and pride of that responsibility.

 - Work directly with senior security engineers, platform engineers, and compliance. You&#39;ll have mentorship, but you&#39;ll also be expected to drive your own work forward.

 - Investigate incidents, review access, harden systems, and close out risks. Not glamorous, but essential, and you&#39;ll learn more from this than any certification could teach you.

 - Automate the boring stuff. If you do something twice by hand, we expect you to script it the third time.

 - Participate in incident reviews, vendor security reviews, and risk discussions. Your voice matters here, even on day one.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - A bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience), graduating between December 2026 and June 2027.

 - Solid fundamentals in networking, operating systems, and how the web actually works (HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication).

 - Scripting ability in at least one language (Python, TypeScript, Bash, etc.). You don&#39;t need to be a software engineer, but you need to be able to read code and write automation.

 - Evidence you can actually do security: CTFs, home labs, security projects, internships, bug bounty submissions, open source contributions. We care about what you&#39;ve broken and fixed, not just what you studied.

 - A hunger to learn and an ego small enough to admit when you don&#39;t know something.

 - Grit. You don&#39;t give up when things get hard. You Google, you read the docs, you ask questions, you figure it out.

 - Strong communication skills. You can explain a finding to an engineer, take feedback without defensiveness, and translate risk for people who aren&#39;t technical.

 - Sound judgment and discretion. We&#39;re a healthcare company handling protected health information, and you&#39;ll be trusted with sensitive access and sensitive situations.

 - Extreme bias toward action. You&#39;d rather ship something imperfect and iterate than wait for perfect.


WHAT YOU&#39;LL LEARN

You&#39;ll get hands-on experience across every domain of a modern security program:

 - Incident response and investigations

 - Cloud security across AWS and GCP

 - Identity and access management (Okta, Google Workspace)

 - Security monitoring and detection

 - Endpoint and corporate security

 - Application and product security

 - HIPAA compliance and security automation


WHY JOIN AS A NEW GRAD?

Most companies will pigeonhole you into one narrow function for years. Here you&#39;ll touch every part of a security program and figure out where you shine. Most companies will give you canned training scenarios. We&#39;ll give you real incidents, real systems, and real patient data to protect. You&#39;ll grow faster here in one year than you would in three years at a big company. It will be hard. You will struggle. And you will come out the other side a dramatically better security engineer.

This is not a job for someone looking for a gentle onboarding process. This is for the new grad who wants to prove they can hang with engineers who have years of experience. If that&#39;s you, we can&#39;t wait to meet you.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You can’t help it: you see something that needs to be fixed, and you try to fix it. You want to pop open the hood, and see how it really works underneath. You don’t just want to get it going again, you want to improve it so that it doesn’t break in that particular way again.

Here at the Solace’s Platform Engineering team, we believe the best platform engineers are generalists. That in order to build reliable, resilient, and anti-fragile systems, you need to understand how systems fail, and how to fix them. We’re looking for new grads with the potential to become expert troubleshooters, and help us build our cloud infrastructure.

This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Help product and data engineers with their tooling and the internal developer platform

 - Help monitor systems health and triage signals

 - Participate in troubleshooting and applying fixes for outages along with the entire platform engineering team. While we don’t expect you to run solo on-call, we do expect you to tag along when systems break.

 - Participate in postmortems, systems analysis and architectural review

 - Ask questions


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - Curiosity about technology, how they work, and how they work with people.

 - A relentless drive to dig deep into the problem and form a picture of what’s going on.

 - Willingness to learn from mistakes and failures.

 - Thinking sideways when obvious approaches are unsuitable.


WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

 - Get very comfortable on the command line and navigating Linux systems.

 - How to gather information on broken systems, form hypotheses, test them, and implement fixes.

 - How to use various mental frameworks to understand and evaluate systems and architecture, and identify patterns, and anti-patterns.

 - How to build infrastructure with GCP, AWS, OpenTofu, and Kubernetes.


SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

Maybe you&#39;re already hosting something for a club or for your friends. Maybe you tried building a home lab, and the parts that broke taught you more than the parts that worked. Maybe you&#39;ve shipped a class assignment and then found yourself more interested in what it was promising to everything around it — where it would fail, who would notice, what depended on it.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn&#39;t just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.


As a Senior Solutions Engineer for Observe, you will play a critical, highly-visible, role within our organization, serving as the primary technical resource for our Sales team. You will be responsible for driving the technical closure of sales opportunities by demonstrating the value of Observe to prospective customers. This role requires a blend of deep technical knowledge, strong presentation skills, and a customer-focused approach.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Technical Discovery and Presentation: Conduct in-depth technical discovery sessions with prospects to understand their current environment, challenges, and specific observability requirements. Tailor and deliver compelling product demonstrations and technical presentations that showcase how our solution addresses their needs.

 - Proof of Concepts (POCs): Design, scope, and manage technical evaluations and Proof of Concepts, ensuring the successful setup and demonstration of value within the customer&#39;s environment. Document findings and present clear, persuasive results back to the customer.

 - Sales Team Support: Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute technical sales strategies. Act as the technical subject matter expert throughout the sales cycle, from initial contact to final contract.

 - Feedback and Product Collaboration: Serve as the voice of the customer to the Product Management and Engineering teams, providing crucial feedback on product capabilities, market needs, and competitive landscape.

 - Content and Training: Develop and maintain technical sales collateral, including demo environments, presentations, and best practice guides. Deliver technical training to the broader Sales organization.

 - Travel: Ability to travel to client sites and industry events as required.


QUALIFICATIONS :

Required

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect in the software industry.

 - Deep technical understanding and practical experience with modern Observability concepts (metrics, logging, tracing) and tools (e.g., Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK Stack).

 - Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices) and major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

 - Experience selling to Developer, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) personas.

 - Prior experience in a fast-paced, high-growth Observability or Application Performance Monitoring (APM) company.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee&#39;s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

The application window is expected to be open until September 22, 2026. This opportunity will remain posted based on business needs, which may be before or after the specified date.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com" />

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role: 
We are seeking Senior Software Engineers to design and develop internal datacenter tooling and infrastructure management systems for Crusoe Cloud, a leading cloud provider. You will play a crucial role in building tools for datacenter facilities managers and capacity planners, as well as creating automation software to efficiently bring server hardware, switches, and other infrastructure components online.

You’ll help evaluate and implement tools and frameworks for our internal customers, focusing on reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and ease of use. This role is central to streamlining infrastructure management processes and enhancing our cloud platform’s overall performance as we dramatically scale our hardware footprint.

Blog Posts About This Team:

What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Designing and developing advanced internal tooling for datacenter facilities managers and capacity planners

 - Creating automation software for rapid deployment and configuration of servers, network switches, power delivery units (PDUs), and coolant delivery units (CDUs)

 - Mentoring junior engineers through design guidance and code reviews to ensure high-quality solutions

 - Innovating and implementing features that streamline infrastructure management and operational capabilities

 - Collaborating with cloud support and operations teams to develop tools that enable growth and empower internal processes

 - Partnering cross-functionally to align goals and optimize resource utilization for improved infrastructure management

 - Leading by example in technical excellence and fostering an environment of innovation in infrastructure and tooling development
   

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - 5+ years of professional software development experience

 - 5+ years of programming experience in at least one modern compiled language (Go, Rust, Java, or C++)

 - 5+ years of experience contributing to architecture and design (patterns, reliability, scaling) of new and existing systems

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or 5–8+ years of equivalent experience

 - Strong computer science fundamentals in data structures and algorithms

 - Proven experience building and maintaining scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems

 - Solid understanding of infrastructure design and operational trade-offs

 - Familiarity with CI/CD practices and build systems (GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, GitHub Actions)

 - Familiarity with modern infrastructure tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform)

 - Experience with concurrency, multithreading, and synchronization

 - Experience with Unix/Linux environments

 - Experience with TCP/IP and network programming

 - Excellent communication skills

 - Alignment with company values
   

Bonus Points:

 - Experience working in large-scale datacenter or cloud environments

 - Hands-on exposure to GPU clusters or high-performance computing environments

 - Background in infrastructure observability or monitoring systems

 - Industry competitive pay

 - Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well-funded technology company

  <meta name="description" content="KEYHOLDER  - FULL-TIME

Dallas, TX - North Park

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.


ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Keyholder, you will help bring our company values to life by creating a service-first culture on the sales floor and supporting smooth store operations. You’ll act as a role model for your peers, delivering exceptional customer experiences, coaching in the moment, and upholding operational excellence. As part of the leadership team, you may serve as Manager on Duty, ensuring the store reflects our brand standards and values in every interaction.


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (80%)

 - Lead and model Rothy’s Experience through exceptional service and selling on the sales floor by coaching and guiding team members to consistently uphold brand standards

 - Drive personal and team sales results, by delivering the Rothy’s Experience to all customers and supporting your teammates through coaching and team selling

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Assist with the execution of in store events and activations that engage the local community, support brand awareness, and drive sales

 - Support with onboarding and training by reinforcing store standards, SOPs, service expectations, selling behaviors, and product knowledge on the sales floor

Team Leadership &amp; Operational Excellence (20%)

 - Act as Manager on Duty when assigned ensuring daily operations, visual merchandising tasks, and service expectations are being met by all team members

 - Own assigned areas of responsibility as part of the Division of Responsibility (DOR) program and communicate progress, opportunities, and feedback to store leadership


YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older


YOU HAVE:

 - 1–2 years of retail or customer service experience, ideally with some leadership responsibility

 - A proven ability to connect with customers and deliver exceptional service

 - Experience supporting operational tasks such as merchandising, shipment, or stockroom leadership

 - A desire to grow your leadership skills

 - Ability to stand/walk an entire shift

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift

 - Availability to work a minimum of 40 hours/week, including peak business days (Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays), holidays, and evening and opening shifts





OUR BENEFITS:

 - Generous paid time off

 - 401k matching

 - Comprehensive health plans for you and your family

 - Supplemental mental health benefits

 - Monthly wellness reimbursement

 - Employee Discount Program!

Please see our Privacy Policy here https://rothys.com/pages/privacy-policy" />

About Jerry.ai

Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren&#39;t just purchases, they&#39;re the physical embodiment of the life you&#39;ve worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. 

We&#39;ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We&#39;re now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto.
